documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Ram Ratna Wires Limited presented its investor presentation for Q2 & H1 FY27. Revenue from operations for Q2 FY27 increased 69% year-on-year, with the copper tubes segment contributing 24% of revenue in the quarter. Management announced the acquisition of EPACK's 50% stake in EPAVO Electricals for ₹15 Cr to turn it into a wholly owned subsidiary, expected to close by November 30, 2026. Furthermore, subsidiary Tefabo is undertaking a phased expansion to increase its wind tower capacity from ~40 to ~80 towers per month. Ram Ratna Wires Limited reported consolidated revenue from operations of Rs.

demand_outlook.claim: Winding wire demand is supported by public-investment drivers such as grid investment, motor efficiency, and smart metering.
demand_outlook.quote: Winding wire demand: four public-investment pools, driven by grid investment, motor efficiency and metering, not discretionary spend

demand_outlook.claim: India imports approximately 70% of its copper tube requirements.
demand_outlook.quote: India imports roughly 70% of its copper tubes — five advantages position Ram Ratna to substitute them

demand_outlook.claim: The revenue share of Copper Tubes & Pipes improved from 14% to 26% due to strategic portfolio diversification.
demand_outlook.quote: Copper Tubes & Pipes share improved significantly from 14% to 26% reflecting strategic diversification, positioning the portfolio for long-term growth and profitability.

demand_outlook.claim: Strategic diversification into copper tubes & pipes helped increase its revenue contribution from 14% to 22%.
demand_outlook.quote: Copper Tubes & Pipes share improved significantly from 14% to 22% reflecting strategic diversification, positioning the portfolio for long-term growth and profitability.

capex_expansion.claim: Ram Ratna Wires proposed acquiring EPACK's 50% stake in EPAVO Electricals for ₹15 Cr to consolidate 100% ownership.
capex_expansion.quote: RRWL to acquire EPACK’s 50% stake for ₹15 Cr

capex_expansion.claim: Production has successfully commenced at the company's Bhiwadi Unit.
capex_expansion.quote: Production Successfully Commenced at Bhiwadi Unit

capex_expansion.claim: Tefabo Product Pvt. Ltd. is expanding capacity at Vadodara from ~40 towers/month to ~80 towers/month.
capex_expansion.quote: Vadodara, Gujarat — undertaking a phased capacity expansion, increasing capacity from ~40 towers/month to ~80 towers/month

capex_expansion.claim: Full-range Level Wound Coil production has commenced, while Inner Grooved Tubes production is currently in progress.
capex_expansion.quote: Full-range Level Wound Coil (LWC) production successfully commenced; Inner Grooved Tubes (IGT) production currently in progress

capex_expansion.claim: Wind turbine tower internal capacity expansion is planned in two phases to reach up to 40 towers per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Expansion planned in two phases; Phase 1 to deliver 20 towers/month, Phase 2 to add another 20 towers/month upon achieving Phase 1 scale

capex_expansion.claim: The company established one of India's largest copper tubes & pipes plants at Bhiwadi, Rajasthan.
capex_expansion.quote: India’s one of the largest copper tubes & pipes plant established at Bhiwadi, driving growth in this segment

margins_costs.claim: Working capital items such as inventories and trade receivables move in line with production volumes and copper prices.
margins_costs.quote: Inventories and receivables rise with volumes and copper prices, independent of capex

margins_costs.claim: An exceptional provision of INR 3.6 crore was made regarding the implementation of new labor codes.
margins_costs.quote: *Exceptional item of INR 3.6 crore pertains to provisions/adjustments related to implementation of new labor codes

orders_capacity.claim: EPAVO Electricals has an installed manufacturing capacity of 30 lakh motors per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: 30 lakh motors/annum installed; >90% localisation in HVLS PMSM motors.

orders_capacity.claim: Copper tubes and pipes contributed 24% of total revenue in Q2 FY27.
The Bhiwadi, Rajasthan plant has an installed capacity of 24,000 MTPA for copper tubes & pipes.
Tefabo Product Pvt. Ltd. holds a 30–40% market share in key product segments.
orders_capacity.quote: Holds 30–40% of the market in key product segments

capital_allocation.claim: Total borrowings rose from ₹296 Cr in FY24 to ₹654 Cr in FY26 alongside an increase in property, plant, and equipment.
capital_allocation.quote: Borrowings ₹296 to ₹654 Cr; PP&E ₹352 to ₹565 Cr

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued bonus equity shares in a 1:1 ratio.
The company acquired an additional 4% stake in Tefabo effective 1st July 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: Acquired an additional 4% stake in Tefabo, effective 1st July 2025

capital_allocation.claim: The company paid a special interim dividend of Rs. 2.50 and a final dividend of Rs 2.50 for FY23-24.
capital_allocation.quote: # Rs. 2.50 Special interim & Rs 2.50 final dividend for FY23-24.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management highlighted risks including economic performance, industry competition, market risk exposure, and strategy execution.
risks_headwinds.quote: These risks and uncertainties include, but are not limited to, the performance of the Indian economy and of the economies of various international markets, the performance of the industry in India and world-wide, competition, the company’s ability to successfully implement its strategy, the Company's future levels of growth and expansion, technological implementation, changes and advancements, changes in revenue, income or cashflows, the Company's market preferences and its exposure to market risks, as well as other risks.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to complete the acquisition of EPACK's 50% stake in EPAVO Electricals by November 30, 2026.
A demo small wind turbine is planned to be installed at Chikmagalur while European tech transfer negotiations progress.
management_commitments.quote: Demo small wind turbine to be installed at Chikmagalur in Q1; European tech transfer agreement in progress

management_commitments.claim: Capacity expansion at Vadodara will be executed in two phases to add 20 towers per month in Phase 1 and an additional 20 towers per month in Phase 2.
management_commitments.quote: Expansion planned in two phases; Phase 1 to deliver 20 towers/month, Phase 2 to add another 20 towers/month upon achieving Phase 1 scale

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
